Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: It misinterprets the truth/lie rule by allowing vampires to utter the true statement “At least one of us is a human” when, by definition, vampires must always lie. With a uniform response, if any human existed the statement would be true and vampires could not say it; the only consistent case with a vampire present is that all 100 are vampires (making the statement false). This is the first decisive misreading that locks in the wrong conclusion.
